title: ID0493078-DC/SI-D/SE-[Y2/U24002962671] Can't charge on outlets 2, 3 and 4
description:
Reported issue/behavior: can only charge on outlet 1
Solution:
Replacement of the crushed wire.

additional_info.body:
Hi,
An urgent problem with the chargers in Norrköping (Y2/U24002962671). It does not work to charge on connectors 2, 3 and 4. It is possible to charge on connector 1 without problems, while as soon as you try to charge on connectors 2, 3 and 4, it is interrupted immediately. Connector 2 was last used yesterday and it was possible to charge without problems while connectors 3 and 4 have not been used so far. It is a newly commissioned charging station.
Sincerely

additional_info.body:
Hi
On todays troubleshoot we found one loose cable on TF1.
We also found after much effort a cable that was stuck between two copper bars and causing short circuit on DC4 minus. This was causing the issue on outlet 2-4.
Please send me the end of line test.

additional_info.subject: Status:
additional_info.body:
After intervention on 4th of May it was possible to found the root-cause.
During inspection, 2 issues were found. TF1 had a loose wiring and there was a cable crushed between the cooper bars. This cable lead to the sessions being aborted in all 4 outlets immediately after addressing more DC groups to the ongoing session. Benders were stopping the session due to low resistance measurements (around 1-2kohm).
